name: migration-studio
description: Developer shortcuts. Everything runs in Docker, so this file has no dependencies.

scripts.seed: docker compose run --rm api python -m data.generator.main --load
scripts.verify: docker compose run --rm api python -m data.generator.verify
scripts.lint:api: docker compose run --rm api sh -c "ruff check /workspace/apps/api /workspace/data /workspace/engines && mypy app"
scripts.test:web: docker compose run --rm --no-deps web sh -c "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm test"
scripts.lint:web: docker compose run --rm --no-deps web sh -c "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run typecheck"
